rules.title: Logic outside views
rules.text: Keep views thin; put business logic in services or model methods.

rules.title: Efficient ORM use
rules.text: Use select_related and prefetch_related to avoid N+1 queries.

rules.title: Migrations
rules.text: Commit migrations with model changes and never edit applied migrations.

rules.title: Split settings
rules.text: Keep settings per environment and read secrets from environment variables.

rules.title: Serializers for validation
rules.text: Validate API input with serializers, not manual request parsing.

rules.title: Custom user model
rules.text: Start projects with a custom user model.

rules.title: Keep CSRF enabled
rules.text: Keep CSRF middleware on and use the csrf_token tag in forms.

rules.title: Use QuerySet methods
rules.text: Filter in the database with QuerySet methods rather than in Python loops.

rules.title: Use signals sparingly
rules.text: Avoid signals for core logic; call services explicitly.

rules.title: Django test tools
rules.text: Use pytest-django or TestCase with factories and test the API layer.
